message.content: The literature depicts human visual perception as a process built from local foveated glimpses, setting it apart from the global computation typical of current computer vision models. Separate work examines self-perception as a psychological construct that selected Neuro-Linguistic Programming techniques may influence and modify. These evaluations of NLP techniques proceed from the perspectives of contemporary cognitive psychology.
